commands: sed -i 's/listen \[::]:443 ssl ipv6only=on; # managed by Certbot/listen [::]:443 ssl ipv6only=on backlog=8192; # managed by Certbot/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
sed -i 's/listen 443 ssl; # managed by Certbot/listen 443 ssl backlog=8192; # managed by Certbot/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

nginx -t 2>&1 && nginx -s reload && echo 'Nginx reloaded OK' || { echo 'FAILED - restoring v5 bak'; cp /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.bak.v5 /etc/nginx/nginx.conf; cp /etc/nginx/conf.d/api-ssl.conf.bak.v5 /etc/nginx/conf.d/api-ssl.conf; nginx -s reload; echo 'restored'; }
